expectations.evidence: Recognized 'accessibility' argument and activated Option 4 (Accessibility Audit) from the /de:review command
Step 1 loaded ui-accessibility skill as the primary review framework
Evaluated text-to-background contrast ratios against WCAG 2.1 AA minimums (4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text), flagged specific elements failing the threshold

expectations.text: Checks touch/tap targets and keyboard navigation
expectations.evidence: Audited minimum tap target sizes (44x44px), checked keyboard focus order, verified all interactive elements reachable via Tab, checked skip-navigation links

expectations.text: Evaluates against WCAG 2.1 AA criteria specifically
expectations.evidence: Structured audit around WCAG 2.1 AA success criteria organized by principle (Perceivable, Operable, Understandable, Robust) with specific criterion references (e.g., 1.4.3, 2.4.7, 3.3.2)

expectations.text: Produces audit report with pass/fail items and priorities
expectations.evidence: Generated a structured audit report with pass/fail status per criterion, severity ratings (critical/major/minor), and prioritized remediation recommendations
